messages:
Alex: quick sync — RFC follow-up on authz checks. thinking to standardize a tiny set of runtime-fast primitives and push the rest to policy-service. goal: cut p50 auth check latency on hot routes.

Maria: can you outline which primitives are in the SDK vs policy? we need clear boundaries.

Alex: propose three local primitives: `is_actor_in_role(actor, role)`, `matches_scope(token, pattern)`, `route_allowed(route, claims)`. these are pure, cacheable, and O(1).

Cheng: cache semantics? suggest LRU with 1s–5s TTL, key = actor+route+role. must support invalidation on binding updates — webhook to regional cache layer.

Maria: fallback contract: if cache miss and policy-service is slow, SDK should support per-route fail-open vs fail-closed. default: admin routes = fail-closed, public read routes = fail-open+audit.

Alex: addability: route config includes `auth_fallback: {mode: 'fail-closed'|'fail-open', audit: bool}`. prototype check API:
```
client.check('route:job.start', token)
// {allowed: bool, reason: 'cache'|'policy'|'deny', ttl_ms: 1200}
```

sre-bot: reminder: add cache invalidation webhook to rollout plan or binding updates will be stale across pods. :warning: 

Cheng: cross-org delegation chains are expensive. plan: include a short provenance chain in token (max depth 3) plus a proof-hash for async verification. runtime only verifies hash (cacheable).

Maria: proof-hash is nice — makes sync decision cheap. but enterprises may require synchronous proof verification; allow per-tenant override.

Alex: metrics to monitor: auth_check_latency.p50/p95, cache_hit_rate per route, decisions.by_reason, fallback_rate. alert if fallback_rate > 0.1% for admin routes.

Cheng: also add traces with decision reason so we can debug fast-path misses.

Maria: compliance note — some tenants must be strictly fail-closed. support tenant-level tag: `require_sync_policy=true` which disables caching for that tenant and forces sync checks.

Alex: next steps: i'll update RFC with primitives, cache invalidation design, token proof-hash proto, and route config schema. ping security/devex for API review.

Cheng: i'll spike auth-sdk changes tomorrow and open draft PR.

Maria: i'll run compliance checklist once PR lands. thanks.

sre-bot: Alex added task 8742 to #eng-infra:auth-cache.
